distinctions: Do not merge yo/me/mí, tú/te/ti, or nosotros/nos: existing cards teach different roles.
Do not infer alguien from alguno, nada from ninguno, or alguno from algo.
Keep accented question forms separate from unaccented relatives.
Uno as a cardinal counts one; indefinite unos/unas mean some, with restrictions in partitives.
Cardinal number-name plurals (doses, treses, etc.), superlatives, archaic forms and attached verb+clitic strings are outside this sense-specific audit.
Vos and vosotros/vosotras are distinct regional pronouns, not missing gender inflections of tú; no new cards are created.
